statements.status_notes: The reported NULL pointer dereference is in OpenJPEG command-line conversion tooling. This image installs libopenjp2-7 via the DHI openjpeg2 source package but does not install the libopenjp2-tools binary package that provides opj_decompress/opj_compress/opj_dump, so the vulnerable CLI path is not present in the image.

The vulnerable Motion JPEG 2000 encoder path is not built: debian/rules passes -DBUILD_MJ2:BOOL=OFF, so lib/openmj2/t2.c is excluded from the produced binary packages.

The trixie OpenJPEG 2.5.3 source already contains the TIFF converter hardening from https://github.com/szukw000/openjpeg/commit/cadff5fb6e73398de26a92e96d3d7cac893af255, including tiSpp/tiBps/dimension validation, bounded row/strip sizing, and encoded-strip size checks in src/bin/jp2/converttif.c.

The trixie OpenJPEG 2.5.3 source already contains the TIFF converter hardening from https://github.com/szukw000/openjpeg/commit/cadff5fb6e73398de26a92e96d3d7cac893af255, including tiSpp/tiBps/dimension validation, bounded row/strip sizing, and encoded-strip size checks in src/bin/jp2/converttif.c.

OpenJPEG 2.5.3 contains the upstream decode-failure handling that makes the reported NULL dereferences no longer reproducible; the historical reports were denial-of-service crashes through opj_decompress CLI paths, not code injection.
